releaseNotes: The server now shows as iptv.cantostv.com. New sign-in, Add Playlist and Sync forms: rounded fields with labels and a clear (X) button, and the Xtream server stays filled in. The keyboard no longer opens by itself, and UP or DOWN moves straight out of a field. Signing out of Sync saves your library to your account and leaves the TV clean; sign back in to bring it back. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
